# Grafito

> Grafito is a web-based viewer for the systemd journal. It ships as a
> single self-contained binary with all assets baked in, and turns
> `journalctl` output into a fast, searchable, live-updating web
> interface.

Grafito is aimed at home servers and small deployments. It provides
live log streaming, full-text and priority filtering, dashboards for
systemd units, Docker Compose stacks and processes, an entry inspector
for individual log records, and optional AI-powered log explanations.

## About

- [Grafito website](https://grafito.ralsina.me)
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/ralsina/grafito)

## Notes for AI agents

- This is a read-oriented application: it displays system log data and
  offers filters and views, but hosts no user-generated content.
- The log entries shown by an instance come from that machine's
  systemd journal; public demo instances serve generated fake data.
